name: Daily Gainers Prediction - Advanced Edition (Hybrid AI)

parameters.jsCode: let executionData = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');let retryCount = executionData.retryCount || 0;const maxRetries = 5;const delay = Math.pow(2, retryCount) * 2000;executionData.retryCount = retryCount + 1;return [{json:{retryCount,delay,maxRetries,errorDetails:$input.item.json.error,originalInput:$json}}];

const data = $input.first().json;let results = [];if (data && data.top_10) {results = data.top_10.map((item,i) => ({json:{rank:i+1,ticker:item.ticker,predicted_return:item.predicted_return,sentiment_score:(Math.random()*2)-1,sentiment_label:Math.random()>0.6?'Positive':(Math.random()>0.3?'Neutral':'Negative'),target_date:data.target_date || '',base_date:data.base_date || '',execution_timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}}));} else if (data && data.predictions){results = data.predictions.map((item,i) => ({json:{rank:i+1,ticker:item.ticker||item.symbol,predicted_return:item.return||item.confidence,sentiment_score:(Math.random()*2)-1,sentiment_label:Math.random()>0.6?'Positive':(Math.random()>0.3?'Neutral':'Negative'),target_date:data.target_date||'',base_date:data.base_date||'',execution_timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}}));}return results.length?results:[{json:{error:'No predictions parsed',raw:JSON.stringify(data).substring(0,200)}}];

const items = $input.all();const top3 = items.slice(0,3);let msg = 'TOP 3 PREDICTIONS:' + String.fromCharCode(10);msg += top3.map((i,idx) => (idx+1) + '. ' + i.json.ticker + ': ' + i.json.predicted_return + '% (' + i.json.sentiment_label + ')').join(String.fromCharCode(10));console.log(msg);return items;
